programme.title: Buddy Vs. Duff
programme.desc: 'S3/E4 - First We Feast'. The teams create cake versions of food feasts. Duff's team makes a realistic farmers market while Buddy and his team create a towering monument of sweet treats.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programme.desc: 'S6/E22 - Dominican Republic'. Andrew is on a culinary tour of the Dominican Republic, a meat lover's paradise. He samples roast pig, seven-meat stew and finds this place full of surprises.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programme.desc: 'S6/E23 - Oaxaca'. Andrew explores regional specialities in Oaxaca, Mexico. From mole negro, tortilla with pork lard to egg bread dunked in hot chocolate, local tradition flavours each bite.

programme.title: Chopped Sweets
programme.desc: 'S2/E4 - Sugary Showpieces'. Four chefs craft towering architectural desserts. First they face challenging duck offal and play with chocolate, strawberry and peanut flavours in round two.

programme.title: Guy's Grocery Games
programme.desc: 'S30/E3 - DDD Dads'. Guy Fieri invites four great chefs and even greater dads to show off their skills. They start by shopping for ingredients for a family favourite.

programme.title: The Kitchen
programme.desc: 'S24/E8 - Herbalicious Dishes'. The chefs demonstrate how to improve any recipe with the fresh herbs of spring. Their menu includes avocado limeade and quick steamed broccoli salad.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S42/E7 - Sicilian Adventure'. Guy Fieri's Sicilian trip continues as he eats creative twists on pizza, next-level langoustine spaghettone, and succulent seafood linguine.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: 'S48/E12 - Burgers And Bravado'. The competing chefs are surprised by parsley cake in round two. Next, the dessert basket includes cara cara oranges and a boozy condiment.

programme.title: Supermarket Stakeout
programme.desc: 'S2/E11 - Trouble In Triple Decker'. In Glendale, CA, the competing chefs make their best barbecue dish. They stack up triple-deckers and find that cinnamon and sugar aren't so sweet.

programme.title: Guy's Grocery Games
programme.desc: 'S27/E9 - Rush To Redemption'. Four previous contestants return for a second chance at proving themselves. But this time, Guy has made success even harder with two rounds of just 20 minutes.

programme.title: The Kitchen
programme.desc: 'S22/E3 - Hot New Trends And Tricks'. The gang shares the hottest summer dishes and trendiest tricks. On the menu are grilled sweet potato salad and an Asian-style veggie burger.

programme.title: Chopped Sweets
programme.desc: 'S2/E5 - Desserts In Bloom'. Flower power meets flour power in a floral-themed dessert competition! Salted blossoms and a flowery cake keep the theme going strong in round two.

programme.title: Bobby's Triple Threat
programme.desc: 'S3/E6 - Titans Vs Ashleigh Shanti'. Bobby invites rising star Ashleigh Shanti to take on the Titans. She keeps them guessing with her unique mix of Appalachian and Southern cooking.

programme.title: Bobby's Triple Threat
programme.desc: 'S3/E7 - Titans Vs Shirley Chung'. Chef Shirley Chung has a bone to pick with Bobby Flay's Titans - especially her former roommate, Brooke Williamson.

programme.title: Bobby's Triple Threat
programme.desc: 'S3/E8 - Titans Vs Marcus Samuelsson'. Bobby invites Marcus Samuelsson to the kitchen to flex his cooking skills. From Sweden to Ethiopia, Marcus throws his global tricks at the Titans.

programme.title: Guy's Grocery Games
programme.desc: 'S30/E4 - Supermarket Of Mischief'. Guy welcomes four GGG superfans to a night of twisted games. The winner will get the once-in-a-lifetime chance to shop in Flavortown for up to $20,000!

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S38/E1 - From Chicken To Caribbean'. Guy Fieri hits up the-bomb fried chicken in Omaha, real deal Caribbean in Cincinnati and over-the-top chicken and dumplings in Redmond, Oregon.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S38/E2 - Variety Of Flavor'. Guy Fieri hits up joints with bountiful flavours, including a Malaysian oasis in Cincinnati, a Salvadorian spot in New York and a pizza bus in Omaha.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: 'S46/E1 - Here To Persevere!'. Host Ted Allen challenges four chefs to make an appetiser using cocktail fruit slices, canned clam sauce and sausage-stuffed pancakes on sticks.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S42/E11 - Bunny Chow To Chicken Oysters'. Guy Fieri's digging into lights-out lamb curry in Black Mountain, NC, beef barbacoa in San Jose, CA, and chicken oysters in Boynton Beach, FL.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S42/E12 - Sandwiches, Sausage & Sweets'. Guy Fieri's savouring crazy cookies in Sacramento, CA, gangster gator sausage in West Palm Beach, FL, and an out-of-bounds Italian sandwich in Tampa.

programme.title: Supermarket Stakeout
programme.desc: 'S6/E9 - A Stick To Your Ribs Stakeout'. Four chefs make stick-to-your-ribs plates before they lighten things up with detox dishes. The two final competitors deliver decadent desserts.

programme.title: The Kitchen
programme.desc: 'S23/E9 - Price Crunch Challenge'. The chefs share recipes that can be made on a tight budget. Alex Guarnaschelli creates cheesy stuffed peppers, while Jeff Mauro cooks a tortilla pizza.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S42/E8 - Global Mashup'. Guy Fieri's going global with Filipino island adobo in Calgary, Alberta, elevated Egyptian BBQ in Austin, Texas, and serious stir-fry near Cincinnati.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: 'S48/E13 - Hangry Baskets: Hungover'. This battle is packed with must-have ingredients for a hangover. A greasy favourite and carbs get the chefs' creative juices flowing in the first round.

programme.title: Ready Jet Cook
programme.desc: 'S2/E5 - Craveable Thai Favorites'. Jet Tila whips up two Thai takeout favourites that are easy to make from home, Ali's favourite panang curry and a late-night staple, drunken noodles.

programme.title: Ready Jet Cook
programme.desc: 'S2/E6 - Irresistible Chicken Dishes'. Jet Tila proves just how delicious chicken can be by serving up a mouthwatering Thai BBQ chicken with papaya salad and three cup chicken.

programme.desc: 'S1/E8'. There is a rich culture and history of street food in Africa. Chef Nti explores the delicious dishes on offer and recreates some of her favourite recipes.

programme.title: Magnolia Table: At The Farm
programme.desc: 'S1/E2 - Cookies Three Ways'. Joanna makes her three favourite cookie recipes: chocolate chip cookies, classic sugar cookies, and her famous Silo cookies.

programme.title: Supermarket Stakeout
programme.desc: 'S2/E12 - Burger Night Bonanza'. It's burger night in the parking lot of Bristol Farms in Calabasas, CA, as the chefs try to craft the perfect burger and make their best midnight snack.

programme.title: Guy's Grocery Games
programme.desc: 'S27/E10 - Firefighter Face-Off'. Guy sounds the alarm as four talented firehouse cooks compete. First, they must grab all the ingredients they need to make a cheesy comfort dinner.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S33/E9 - Alaskan Adventure'. Guy embarks on a culinary adventure in Alaska. He checks out a German food truck and a food-and-music restaurant that serves Cuban favourites.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S33/E10 - Takeout: Goin' Big'. Guy and Hunter get inspiration from a Wyoming chef to make a tasty Stromboli. The menu also includes seafood stew and cinnamon rolls.

programme.title: Man Fire Food
programme.desc: 'S6/E25 - Pit Bosses'. Roger Mooking honours legendary pitmasters making the best barbecue in the US. And, he visits a Texas market with traditions dating back to their opening in 1900.
